items.summary: fix(process): require cleanup evidence before releasing owned work (#139517) * fix(process): retain cleanup evidence for owned work Keep root results separate from process cleanup. Confirm owned POSIX group extinction after graceful anchor retirement and retain failed cleanup for scope and supervisor owners. Preserve output drainage when diagnostic streams detach and keep Linux zombie leaders with live threads active. Migrate local TUI shell shutdown to pre-acquired cleanup ownership. This is the process foundation for Stage 3 of the #135868 split; remaining agent and transport consumers follow in the dependent PR. * test(process): prove buffered output drains after detachment
